fields.name: game work memory
fields.meaning: Everything below 5FC8 is live game memory (the game keeps its working variables on the save chip); the save itself is the framed copy at 6000
fields.evidence: code: live variables at segment 1000 offsets 0936-52da; every step changes it

fields.name: work area below save
fields.meaning: Not save data: written on every power-on even with blank memory and never read before being rewritten; most likely the top of the game stack
fields.evidence: diff boot->power-on (written at first power-on); boot reads (not read first)

fields.name: copy 0 start marker
fields.meaning: Start marker of the first save copy, always 02; a copy without it counts as empty
fields.evidence: code d000:5744 writes, d000:586e checks; appears on save

fields.name: copy 0 length
fields.meaning: Length of the saved data block that follows (always 0B1F = 2847 bytes)
fields.evidence: code d000:574f..5762 writes CX=0xb1f passed by d000:5b06

fields.name: game tag
fields.meaning: Which of the two games on the cartridge the save belongs to: Anode Tamer or Cathode Tamer tag, 15 characters and a 00; Continue first tries the copy as Anode, then as Cathode, and a copy whose tag matches neither is rejected. The natural saves are Anode Tamer saves
fields.evidence: code d000:59a4 picks the tag from the ROM by the game-side flag, d000:5b5b compares 16 bytes, d000:2ec1 tries side 0 then 1; ROM file offsets 0x3c2daa/0x3c2dba

fields.name: resume mode
fields.meaning: Where Continue resumes: 0 = on the field map (normal save from the field menu); 1 is set after battle/event code, 2 by a second saving routine
fields.evidence: code d000:8467 sets 0 before saving, f000:cfca sets 1, d000:aa10 sets 2; natural saves 0

fields.name: money
fields.meaning: Player funds, 0 here
fields.evidence: code: 32-bit add f000:aff6/d296 and sub f000:afc4, d000:cd47/cee7/d06d, clamped to 99,999,999 (0x05F5E0FF, f000:b00e/b014); zeroed at new game f000:bf9d

fields.name: battle points
fields.meaning: Counter raised in battles (+1 per matching fighter, +3 per finished opponent) and capped at 10000, then reset to 0 by story events; 13 in the natural save
fields.evidence: code e000:a0ef/a13c (+1), e000:a173/a1aa (+3), e000:a1b4 (cap 0x2710), d000:94b3 reset; rises 0..13 across early battle states

fields.name: Digimon list
fields.meaning: 30 Digimon records of 0x48 (72) bytes each; only the first is used in the natural saves; per-byte rows below are for record 0 and apply to every record
fields.evidence: code d000:59db copies 0x870 bytes from the live list; used records 0..count-1

fields.name: record: in use
fields.meaning: 1 = this record holds a Digimon, 0 = empty
fields.evidence: code f000:0ce3 and e000:b6ed test it; record0=1, records1-29=0

fields.name: record: species
fields.meaning: Species number (2 = Agumon in the natural save); used to mark the species as owned and to fetch starting values from the ROM species table
fields.evidence: code f000:0ce3 indexes the species table with it; status screen shows Agumon; ROM name list at file 0x370040

fields.name: record: name
fields.meaning: Nickname of the Digimon ("Agumon"), in the game letter codes (A=0x21..Z=0x3A, a=0x3E..z=0x57, space=00), ended and padded with FF
fields.evidence: Unit list and status screens show it; gift code fills it from the ROM species name list d000:5e28

fields.name: record: second name
fields.meaning: A second name in the same letter codes ("Biyomon" in the natural save); copied from the 8 ROM bytes after the species name (f000:02da, d000:9552); not shown on the Unit list or status screens; the gift path leaves it empty (FF)
fields.evidence: dump + code copy mechanics; meaning unknown

fields.name: record: MP max
fields.meaning: Value 3; status screen shows MP 3/3, so this is likely one half of an MP max/current pair with +0x1F (order unproven); from the ROM species table
fields.evidence: status screen MP 3/3; ROM species table file 0x3c0260+species*23

fields.name: record: bytes 13-14
fields.meaning: Unknown (zero)
fields.evidence: dump only

fields.name: record: DP
fields.meaning: Digimon health, 150 for Agumon (status screen "DP 150/150")
fields.evidence: status screen match; ROM species table

fields.name: record: AP
fields.meaning: Attack points, 32 (screen "AP 32/32")
fields.evidence: status screen match; ROM species table

fields.name: record: PP
fields.meaning: PP, 7 (screen "PP 7/7"); stored before SP although the screen lists SP first
fields.evidence: status screen match; ROM species table

fields.name: record: SP
fields.meaning: SP, 10 (screen "SP 10/10")
fields.evidence: status screen match; ROM species table

fields.name: record: VP
fields.meaning: VP, 24 (screen "VP 24/24")
fields.evidence: status screen match; ROM species table

fields.name: record: MP current
fields.meaning: Value 3; likely MP current (pair with +0x12; order unproven); from the ROM species table
fields.evidence: status screen MP 3/3; ROM species table

fields.name: record: cycle countdown
fields.meaning: Starts 8 (species table); decremented once per ~161-step walking cycle unless 0; mechanics confirmed, purpose unknown
fields.evidence: code e000:b7f9..b834 (species threshold 160 for Agumon from ROM tables)

fields.name: record: UP current
fields.meaning: Starts 0; +1 per 150 steps, capped at 8; likely UP current (screen "UP 0/6")
fields.evidence: code e000:b72a..b779; status screen

fields.name: record: bytes 22-23
fields.meaning: Unknown (zero)
fields.evidence: dump only

fields.name: record: steps in cycle
fields.meaning: Step counter within the current ~161-step cycle (++ per step event, reset when the species threshold is reached); 3 -> 43 -> 44 across the three saves
fields.evidence: code e000:b718/b834; diffs between saves; live value rises while walking

fields.name: record: steps mod 150
fields.meaning: Step counter modulo 150 (++ per step event, reset at 150 while +0x21 increments); equals +0x24 here (both below 150)
fields.evidence: code e000:b706/b779; diffs between saves

fields.name: record: bytes 26-33
fields.meaning: Unknown Digimon data (zero); new-game and record-setup code touch +0x26/+0x2F/+0x30 individually, so these hold separate subfields

fields.name: record: technique slots
fields.meaning: Ten 2-byte slots, all (FF,00) here: likely ten per-Digimon technique slots, empty; exact subformat unproven
fields.evidence: dump only

fields.name: item list
fields.meaning: 32 item-id slots, FF = empty (02 then FF fill here)
fields.evidence: code: append f000:05a0, consume f000:0563, battle lookups with 17-byte ROM params e000:179e; starter + story events grant entries

fields.name: item count
fields.meaning: Entries used in the item list (1)
fields.evidence: code f000:05a0/0563/0579 maintain it; compared against 0x20/7

fields.name: Digimon count
fields.meaning: Number of used records in the Digimon list (1)
fields.evidence: code f000:0ce3 loop bound; d000:5dd5 compares with capacity and appends at this index; f000:02da sets 1

fields.name: timers A
fields.meaning: 3 countdown bytes, FF = inactive (FF FF FF); ticked down alongside timers B while below a threshold
fields.evidence: code f000:8b61..8b81 tick, f000:5582 compare; purpose unknown

fields.name: timer count
fields.meaning: Active entries in the two timer arrays, 0..3 (0)
fields.evidence: code f000:8b52 loop bound; f000:5568 ==3 branch; writers f000:5b53/55d1

fields.name: unknown 0a30
fields.meaning: Unknown byte (0); only saved/loaded and zeroed at new game
fields.evidence: code f000:c071; no other use

fields.name: event triggers
fields.meaning: 18 story-event request flags; 1 requests the matching event (the first is set at new game, 1 in the natural saves, still pending)
fields.evidence: code f000:c085 sets first to 1; tested by field/event code d000:88c0/9483.., f000:cfdc

fields.name: Digimon capacity
fields.meaning: How many Digimon the player may hold; 8 at new game, raised by 2 or 3 by story events (8 in the natural saves)
fields.evidence: code f000:c08a sets 8, d000:95e2/96bb add 2, d000:97e3 adds 3, d000:cb02 adds 5; d000:5dd5 compares count < capacity

fields.name: species table
fields.meaning: One byte per species (113): 2 = owned (refreshed from the Digimon list before every save), 1 = seen, 0 = unknown
fields.evidence: code f000:0ce3 sets 2; Betamon and Kuwagamon flipped 0->1 at the first-battle states

fields.name: parallel species table
fields.meaning: 73-byte table filled with 2 by the same completion routine that fills the species table (all zero here); exact role unknown
fields.evidence: code d000:69e2..69ef; indexed use e000:c491, f000:96ea

fields.name: per-species counters
fields.meaning: 113 per-species counters, ++ with cap 100 from chapter tables (all zero here; chapter 0 never runs it); likely battle/rank counters
fields.evidence: code d000:9cd4..9f0d (++cap 100), e000:1d31/eaf1, f000:6f7e read, f000:c0b1 init 0

fields.name: stale block
fields.meaning: 216 bytes copied into the save but NEVER copied back on load, so the saved bytes are dead (all zero); live use is 3 x 72-byte records
fields.evidence: code: d000:58ef packs it, d000:5b3d restores 0x0A5A then 0x0A38, skipping it; live use f000:44xx/8a2e

fields.name: unknown 0a38
fields.meaning: Unknown 11 bytes (zero); only saved/loaded and zeroed at new game
fields.evidence: code f000:c0d8; no other use

fields.name: map number
fields.meaning: Map the player is on (4 = lake house area, 1 = facility hub, 3 = west map across the three saves)
fields.evidence: diffs between saves; set by field/story code d000:78f9/d000:946e

fields.name: player X
fields.meaning: Player X position on the map (0x48/0x18/0xC8 across the three saves)
fields.evidence: diffs; live value follows walking; code d000:8f0c/8f18 increments/decrements it

fields.name: player Y
fields.meaning: Player Y position on the map (0x58/0x48/0x48)
fields.evidence: diffs; code d000:8f06/8f12

fields.name: map asset table
fields.meaning: 18 bytes counting 00..11: per-map index into ROM tile/data tables
fields.evidence: code d000:7717/8bfc index it by map id into ROM tables; identity written at new game f000:c110

fields.name: event flag 369e
fields.meaning: 0/1 story flag, set during event processing (0 here)
fields.evidence: code d000:9b45/9b76 set 1, d000:981b tests, f000:c106 clears

fields.name: event done flags
fields.meaning: 12 flags set to 1 when a story event has been played (all 0 in the natural saves)
fields.evidence: code d000:949b/94ed/9521.. set them; cleared at new game f000:c0e3

fields.name: event flag 3796
fields.meaning: One-time flag, set 0->1 once (0 here)
fields.evidence: code d000:b526 sets, d000:929b/b515 test, f000:c16a clears

fields.name: tamer name
fields.meaning: Tamer name from the name-entry screen (default "RYO"), in the game letter codes, FF end/pad
fields.evidence: name-entry screenshot; passed to dialogue rendering d000:9c28 ("I saved the game for you, RYO."); FF scan f000:ce8f

fields.name: unknown 52d1
fields.meaning: Unknown 9 zero bytes after the name within the copied 20-byte block
fields.evidence: dump only

fields.name: counter 384c
fields.meaning: Small counter compared with 3 and incremented (0 here); purpose unknown
fields.evidence: code d000:ce85 compares, d000:d075 increments, f000:c10b clears

fields.name: story progress
fields.meaning: Story progress id: 0x1E at new game, advanced to 0x1F/0x20 by story events (0x1E here)
fields.evidence: code f000:c053 sets 1E, d000:94ae/953f advance, d000:ccc5 compares

fields.name: chapter
fields.meaning: Chapter/event id 0..0x11 (0 here); indexes event triggers and ROM tables
fields.evidence: code d000:7ecf jump table sets 1..0x11, e000:816e/818a inc/dec, f000:cfdc indexes triggers

fields.name: stage
fields.meaning: Stage/round id paired with the chapter, 0..0xB (0 here); one saving routine raises it by one just for the save and lowers it after
fields.evidence: code d000:65ec.. compares, e000:8280/82a3 inc/dec, f000:e03f/e048 around a save

fields.name: table 0948
fields.meaning: Three unknown 16-bit values (zero), indexed reads and writes
fields.evidence: code e000:8e26 reads, f000:d847 writes

fields.name: table 1340
fields.meaning: Three unknown 16-bit values (zero), same accessor pair as table 0948
fields.evidence: code e000:8e42 reads, f000:d86b writes

fields.name: timers B
fields.meaning: 3 countdown bytes, FF = inactive (FF FF FF); decremented alongside timers A
fields.evidence: code f000:8b77 tick, f000:557a compare, f000:c061 init FF; purpose unknown

fields.name: gated counter
fields.meaning: A 32-bit counter raised only when a system call returns 0 (never in this playthrough, always 0), capped near 70010, with a flag set past 70000
fields.evidence: code d000:a07e/a086/a097, f000:bfb5 init 0; purpose unknown

fields.name: copy 0 end marker
fields.meaning: End marker, always 03
fields.evidence: code d000:5784 writes, d000:588c checks

fields.name: copy 0 checksum
fields.meaning: CRC-16/KERMIT over the length field, data and end marker (copy bytes 1..0xB22), stored low byte first
fields.evidence: recomputed on 96 save copies (3 distinct saves); code d000:05f7 with tables at d000:0637/0737

fields.name: copy 0 padding
fields.meaning: Unused gap between copies (zero)
fields.evidence: code: copies are 0xB29 apart, block is 0xB25 long

fields.name: copy 1 (backup)
fields.meaning: Second identical copy with the same layout as 6000-6B28, written right after the first on every save; read only when the first copy is missing, damaged or has the wrong tag
fields.evidence: code d000:5b01/5b13 write copies 0 and 1; d000:5b3d falls back to copy 1; copies identical in all saves

fields.name: gap after save
fields.meaning: Unused by the save (zero)
fields.evidence: diffs across saves

fields.name: gift mailbox
fields.meaning: 16 bytes checked after loading against the tag text for a bonus delivery; when they match and there is room, the Digimon record that follows at 7810 is added to the list (its name filled from the species name list), the game saves itself and the mailbox is cleared; zero in the natural saves
fields.evidence: code d000:5de1..5eb6; boot reads (7800 read after load); delivery trigger (link feature?) unproven

fields.name: gift record
fields.meaning: The Digimon record delivered with the gift mailbox (same 72-byte layout as the list records)
fields.evidence: code d000:5e1a..5e8f copies 0x48 bytes from 7810

fields.name: rest of chip
fields.meaning: Unused by the save (zero)
fields.evidence: diffs across saves
